direction: vertical only — the frame rides up a little with each climbing attempt and drops back with her; no lateral, no tilt, no push
speed: three short rises of about 0.10 m at roughly 0.12 m/s, each one shorter than the last, each dropping back to the 0.15 m base as she slides down
speed_curve: three_beats_ease_out (rise, slip back, rest — repeated three times, each beat shorter than the last)
camera_height_m: 0.15 base, riding to about 0.25 at the top of each attempt
start_frame: One frame at the foot of the glass leg, lens on the flagstones: Alice wrapping both arms round the clear glass leg, the leg running up out of the top of frame, a flagstone joint crossing the near foreground.
end_frame: The same frame back at its lowest after the third and shortest attempt: she has slid down onto the flags again, the leg still running out of frame above her and the joint still under her feet — nothing gained.
constraint_honoured: 'Three climbing attempts as written; contingency trim T8 is a screenplay change and is NOT taken. The failures are physical, not sad' — the camera only ever follows her body up and down, and never comments.
movement_note: Single axis, single movement type; the amplitude is deliberately tiny (≈0.10 m) so the model reads one gentle vertical follow rather than a compound move. Written into shot_list's camera_position ('riding up a little with each attempt and dropping back with her') and honoured as the minimum move that satisfies it.
